description:
Fixes GitHub issue theodoreOnzGit/kopitiam#31 (Type1/predefined-encoding-CFF text rendered as solid colour boxes).

Implemented:
- crates/kopitiam-pdf/src/mupdf/glyph_type1.rs: a from-spec Type1 charstring interpreter (Adobe Type 1 Font Format spec) -- PFA/PFB unwrapping, eexec + charstring decryption, hsbw/sbw/seac/flex (OtherSubrs 0-3)/div, built-in /Encoding parsing.
- crates/kopitiam-pdf/src/mupdf/font.rs: wires Type1Program in as a name-selected sibling to the GID-selected FontProgram (new LoadedFontProgram enum), /Length1//Length2 boundary hints, per-code glyph_names retained for name-based selection.
- crates/kopitiam-pdf/src/mupdf/glyph_cff.rs: predefined-Standard-encoding resolution for simple CFF fonts (code -> name via encodings::STANDARD -> SID via the 391-entry CFF_STANDARD_STRINGS table -> gid via the charset). Predefined Expert encoding remains a documented ceiling (falls back to advance box).
- End-to-end draw_device.rs test (ring-glyph discriminator) proves a Type1 glyph now renders a real letterform, not a filled box.

See AID-0055 for the 'hayro-font as a dependency' decision (declined; from-spec implementation kept) and docs/ai-decisions/README.md index.
title: kopitiam-pdf: Type1 (/FontFile) glyph outlines + predefined-Standard CFF encoding
